verified_gates.rule: INSPIRE download dataset is published 2026-07-05 and monthly files refresh on the first Sunday.
INSPIRE contains freehold registered property locations in England and Wales.
Each INSPIRE polygon has a unique Land Registry-INSPIRE ID relating to a registered title.
INSPIRE polygons show position and indicative extent; registered-title extent cannot be established from INSPIRE alone.
A registered title can contain several polygons and each polygon has a separate INSPIRE ID.
A polygon on a local-authority boundary may appear in both authority files.
HMLR INSPIRE polygon coordinates are captured against British National Grid EPSG:27700.
BNG to web-map reprojection may shift features by up to 15 metres; matching stays in EPSG:27700.
Title plans show general boundaries unless determined under section 60; ordinary title plans are not exact-boundary evidence.
Current INSPIRE data is supplied as GML by local authority.
EA Composite DTM 1m is terrain-only elevation data suitable as the primary numeric source once polygon geometry is validated.
EA DTM is aligned to OS National Grid EPSG:27700.
EA DTM heights are metres referenced to Ordnance Datum Newlyn and use OSTN15 transformation.
Individual LIDAR surveys used by the composite have vertical accuracy +/-15 cm RMSE.
Time-stamped DTM metadata provides survey date, resolution and transformation/geoidal-model lineage.
OS Terrain 50 is a broad-scale DTM crosscheck, not the parcel-range primary source.
OS Terrain 50 grid uses 10 km tiles with 200x200 pixels at 50 m spacing.
OS Terrain 50 height values are calculated from pixel centres and stored to nearest 0.1 m.

blocked_gates.rule: Current Barnet/Enfield raw GML bytes must be retrieved before exact identity promotion.
Downloaded/extracted HMLR GML SHA-256 must be recorded.
Exact INSPIRE ID must be extracted from the fresh GML feature containing the candidate point.
Candidate BNG point must be proven inside the exact fresh HMLR polygon.
Matched feature must be bound to Barnet or Enfield authority evidence.
Cross-authority duplicate geometry must be deduplicated; conflicting duplicate geometry must be rejected.
Fresh HMLR geometry must topologically equal geometry used for EA/OS sampling.
EA DTM 1m runtime service/download must succeed for the matched polygon.
EA raster/tile source SHA-256 and provenance must be recorded.
At least three valid EA DTM 1m pixel centres must fall inside the official polygon.
Direct pixel-centre elevation samples must be persisted and finite.
Official height difference must be max-minus-min of validated EA DTM 1m pixel-centre samples.
OS Terrain 50 official tile download must succeed for the candidate crosscheck.
OS crosscheck tile metadata must prove EPSG:27700 and ODN/Newlyn vertical reference.
Independent OS Terrain 50 candidate sample must be finite and inside the required tile.
EA-vs-OS absolute elevation difference must not exceed the 8 m conflict gate.
Remote revision-14 runtime output 016 must exist and pass schema/provenance checks.
Remote integrity readback 025 must exist and match runner/web snapshot hashes.
